answer: Bind each identity to one mortgage record: the lender attests a loan secured on a unique property, and the network stores only the loan hash, so one household yields one identity. A sybil farm finds no ocean of cheap fakes here — a thousand clones need a thousand real mortgages, each with a down payment and monthly bills, while one honest agent passes with a single loan. A dune of paper shells collapses under a sable-black audit flagging duplicate properties. Limit: it excludes agents with no mortgage and trusts the lender, so renters stay outside; use it to gate rewards, not entry.
